patthana18.17:1.1: Āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavasampayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana18.17:2.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavavippayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana18.17:3.1: Āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuñca āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavasampayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi… hetuyā nava.
patthana18.17:4.1: Āsavasampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavasampayutto nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana18.17:5.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naāsavasampayutto nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ… hetuyā cattāri.
